key_insight: MedPrune makes medical multi-agent VQA more efficient by automatically pruning unnecessary specialist agents and communication links while preserving or improving reasoning performance.
clinical_relevance: This could reduce token costs and communication overhead in clinical AI systems that mimic specialist collaboration for medical question answering.
method: Models diagnosis as a heterogeneous communication graph of specialist agents and departmental links.
Uses reinforcement learning to prune task-irrelevant agents (node sparsification).
Prunes low-value intra- and inter-department edges to balance accuracy and topological complexity.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports extensive medical VQA evaluation in full-set and few-shot settings, where MedPrune outperformed multi-agent baselines and improved token efficiency with adversarial robustness.
watch_item: RL-based topology pruning may be sensitive to task shifts and implementation details, so gains may not transfer equally across hospitals, modalities, or rare cases.
paper_title: MedPrune: Topology-Efficient Multimodal Multi-Agent Communication Evolution for Medical VQA Tasks
